ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark) base with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/light) pixel clusters representing surface scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation across both lobes with discrete, high-contrast circular white blobs (rosettes) distributed throughout. High-density accumulation of white pixels at the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 65-75 degrees and a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge characterized by jagged peaks and valleys of varying pixel amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the lateral tips, which terminate in sharp upward-pointing vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular, high-contrast white-on-black pixel clusters across the entire ventral surface, with high-density aggregations at the outer margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring patterns characterized by circular ring-like lesions and high-intensity barnacle-related markings across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy encrustation of white, high-contrast material at the extreme distal ends of both lobes, creating a textured, irregular margin.
